mentions.name: Music audio vector similarity database
mentions.description: This database stores audio metadata (including links back to sources like YouTube or Spotify) along with vector embeddings for the audio, enabling similarity search: grab clips of music from YouTube, generate vectors for them, and find similar items in the database. It is initially populated with YouTube-8M and AudioSet data.
mentions.problem: Initial search results are weird because the database was populated with YouTube-8M and AudioSet, neither of which are music-specific.
mentions.source_excerpt: A database populated with audio metadata (including a link back to YouTube or Spotify or whatever) that includes vector embeddings for the audio. That way I can grab clips of music I like from YouTube, generate vectors for them, then find similar things in the database.
